name: Tinfou Dunes
hero_subtitle: Accessible sand dunes south of Zagora — a first taste of the Sahara without a long expedition.

overview.title: Small dunes, real sand
overview.p1: The Tinfou dunes will not rival Erg Chigaga in scale, but they offer real Saharan sand close to Zagora — climb, photograph, ride a short camel loop or simply watch the light change.
overview.p2: On busy days it can feel like a playground; early or late visits are calmer. Combine with Tamegroute if you want culture and dunes in one outing.
overview.p3: Bring water, closed shoes for hot sand, and a sense of proportion: this is an appetiser, not the whole desert.

q1.question: How far from Zagora?
q1.answer: Roughly 25–30 km south — about a 30-minute drive from town.

q2.question: Camel rides?
q2.answer: Often offered on site; agree price and duration before you mount.

q3.question: Good for kids?
q3.answer: Yes for a short climb and play — supervise on steep faces.

q4.question: Sunset?
q4.answer: Popular; arrive before the peak light if you want space.

q5.question: Overnight?
q5.answer: Possible nearby; many visitors come for a few hours only.
